properties.inscription:en: BUILT IN 1574, ENLARGED IN 1683. THIS BUILDING WAS OCCUPIED BY THE ITALIAN KNIGHTS OF ST JOHN WHO WERE ENTRUSTED WITH THE DEFENCE OF ST PETER AND PAUL'S BASTIONS. THEIR CHIEF WAS THE ADMIRAL OF THE ORDER.
This House with Siculo-Norman features was built in the 13th Century. Prominent is the double-light window with Gothic arcading and the Norman style friezing along the façade.
